synthetic_example_note: UI fixture generated for frontend/src/ghosttrace by a scratch script: invented targets, habitat outlines, currents and alerts, shaped like ghosttrace/schema.md. change.previous_latitude/longitude and diver_brief.thresholds are UI-exercising extras not in the engine contract.
title: GhostTrace example (synthetic)

data_sources.name: Synthetic uniform current + tidal term (UI fixture)

caveats: EVERYTHING IN THIS EXAMPLE IS SYNTHETIC: targets, habitat outlines, currents and alerts were generated for the interface fixture.
Activity is a heuristic from fish-echo enrichment near the object; it indicates, it does not prove, that a net is catching fish.
Habitat outlines are approximate; distances are to the outline vertices and may be off by the outline's own error.
Drift probabilities are shares of simulated particles under an assumed current, not calibrated forecasts.
Priority score weights are a configurable project choice, not an official standard.
Alerts are drafts. Nothing is sent automatically.

activity.basis: echo clusters in the water column beside the detection compared with control windows on the same side of the same line (UI fixture values); configurable heuristic chosen for this project; not fitted to real ghost-gear recovery data and not an official procedure
activity.limitations: Water-column echoes near the net may be fish, bubbles, suspended sediment or turbulence; the method cannot tell them apart. It has not been validated on real ghost-net data. A high score is evidence of biological aggregation (or other scatterers) near the object, not proof of entanglement or that the net is still catching.

current_source.name: Synthetic uniform current + tidal term (UI fixture)

drift.mode_basis: UI fixture: modelled as floating so the playback has something to show; the engine defaults to seabed for side-scan contacts
assumptions: Net drifts as a passive surface-following tracer (no windage term).
Current field is uniform and synthetic; tide modelled as a 12.42 h sinusoid.
Particle speeds scaled ±40% and a random walk added to represent uncertainty.
limitations: A net anchored to the seabed or snagged on a reef may not move at all.
No real ocean model or wind data was used for this example.
Probabilities are shares of 150 simulated particles, not calibrated odds.

reasons: Net height 1.5 m in 14 m of water: top of net ~12.5 m below surface — within draft-plus-wake of trawlers operating here.
Floats observed on the headrope in the sonar record may lift loose panels.
Within 3.1 km of an active fishing harbour (synthetic layer).

diver_brief.recommended_method: Two-diver team with line cutters and lift bags; surface support vessel on station; cut free in sections rather than lifting whole.
notes: Thresholds are this project's configured planning values, not a certification standard.
Confirm depth and current on site before any dive.

change.basis: Matched to a prior contact 18 m away (within the 50 m match radius); treated as the same object, not moved.

drift_impact.basis: max drift impact probability on a sensitive layer

recoverability.basis: mean of depth ease and current ease

priority.formula: score = confidence.value * sum(weight * value for every other term) (= confidence.value * sum(contribution))
